# opstracer_service (Resource)

An OpsTracer service. Alerts for a service are paged through its escalation policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_service" "checkout" {
  name                 = "checkout-api"
  description          = "Checkout API"
  escalation_policy_id = opstracer_escalation_policy.backend.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `escalation_policy_id` (String) ID of the escalation policy that pages for this service.
- `name` (String) Service name, unique in the org.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_service.checkout <service-id>
```
